item.title: Lulu, Kirsty Wark and Alan Cumming to Launch Pitlochry Festival Theatre’s 75th Anniversary Appeal
item.description: Pitlochry Festival Theatre launches its 75th anniversary appeal with Lulu, Kirsty Wark, Alan Cumming and a free costume exhibition, marking a major cultural moment as the Highland theatre looks boldly towards its future.The post Lulu, Kirsty Wark and Alan Cumming to Launch Pitlochry Festival Theatre’s 75th Anniversary Appeal appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Scotland Commits £30 Billion to Infrastructure Investment by 2030
item.description: Scotland has unveiled plans to invest £30 billion in infrastructure by 2030, backing housing, transport, the NHS, climate resilience and Highland connectivity as part of the 2026-27 Budget and long-term Spending Review.The post Scotland Commits £30 Billion to Infrastructure Investment by 2030 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Scotland Secures Offshore Wind Wins but Highlands Face Ongoing Barriers in Record UK Auction
item.description: Scotland has secured two offshore wind projects in a record UK auction, but concerns remain that the Highlands are being held back by unfair grid charges, limiting jobs, investment and long-term economic benefit from renewable energy.The post Scotland Secures Offshore Wind Wins but Highlands Face Ongoing Barriers in Record UK Auction appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Labour Ditches Brit Cards as Sarwar Left Exposed by Starmer U-Turn
item.description: Labour has abandoned its controversial Brit Cards policy after fierce opposition, leaving Scottish Labour leader Anas Sarwar exposed after publicly backing the scheme, as critics point to growing chaos and repeated U turns from Westminster.The post Labour Ditches Brit Cards as Sarwar Left Exposed by Starmer U-Turn appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland Opportunities to be Pitched on Global Stage at Scottish Cities Week
item.description: Highland investment opportunities will be promoted to global investors at Scottish Cities Week in London, as The Highland Council showcases clean energy, infrastructure and skills projects aimed at driving long term, inclusive growth across the region.The post Highland Opportunities to be Pitched on Global Stage at Scottish Cities Week appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Ferry Funding Secured as Orkney Replacement Programme Moves Forward
item.description: Funding has been secured for the first phase of Orkney’s Ferry Replacement Programme, paving the way for three new vessels to serve island communities and marking a major step forward for transport resilience across Orkney.The post Ferry Funding Secured as Orkney Replacement Programme Moves Forward appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Planning Approval Granted for New Forres Academy
item.description: Planning approval has been granted for a new Forres Academy, paving the way for a modern three storey school with extensive sports and community facilities to serve pupils and residents across Forres and Moray.The post Planning Approval Granted for New Forres Academy appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: More Reform Needed if Crofting is to Thrive
item.description: A Highlands MSP has warned that further reform is urgently needed to secure the future of crofting, saying current legislation falls short of supporting crofters to meet climate, food and land use challenges.The post More Reform Needed if Crofting is to Thrive appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A9 Dualling Delivery Plan Confirms Capital Funding and Accelerated Northern Works
item.description: The Scottish Government has confirmed capital funding for the remaining A9 dualling works, with a new delivery plan accelerating key junction upgrades in the Highlands and setting out a clear route to full dualling by 2035.The post A9 Dualling Delivery Plan Confirms Capital Funding and Accelerated Northern Works appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Appeal After Housebreakings in Lochaber
item.description: Two housebreakings in Lochaber have prompted a police appeal after cash and jewellery were stolen from properties near Spean Bridge and in Banavie, Fort William, with officers asking locals to check CCTV and report suspicious activity.The post Appeal After Housebreakings in Lochaber appeared first on The Highland Times.
